decision.text: the hollow reading anchors at f8f2e842 (the PROVEME->BUILDME rebuild that replaced socket.gethostname with os.uname), so the standing build is that one change; add tooth test_the_shim_dials_nothing_to_name_its_host to cairn/devices/cc/proofs/test_an_idle_cc_session_is_told_it_has_mail.py: it parses cairn/devices/cc/shim.py with ast, asserts no Import/ImportFrom of socket, urllib or requests, and asserts CCShim.poke_target() == f'{os.uname().nodename}_cc_0'; shim.py is not touched again, so the anchor stays f8f2e842 and the reverted shim (which imports socket) reds the tooth; then commit the proof, cross BUILDME, PROVEME, and run cairn test --hollow 1e2640bad4dd --seal before PROVED
